releases.title: HIM v0.1.1
releases.notes:
HIM 0.1.1 brings sign-up, file sharing, saved conversations and more.

**New**
- **Get a Screen Name** opens VesperNet's messenger sign-up page, https://agora.vespernet.net/messenger (0.1.0 sent people to the wrong page).
- **Send File:** send pictures and files to a buddy with the Send File button in an IM window. They choose Accept or Decline; files land in Downloads/HIM. Pictures show right in the conversation; click one to open it full size.
- **Conversations are kept** on your computer, so an IM window opens where you left off.
- **BadassBuddy Icons:** My HIM > Buddy Icon > **BadassBuddy Icons...** opens the BadassBuddy.com collection, built in. Icons courtesy of [BadassBuddy.com](https://www.badassbuddy.com) ♥ (© BadassBuddy.com, used by permission; see LICENSE-ICONS.txt).
- **Suggested buddies** on VesperNet: John (who made HIM) and SmarterChild, if you'd like them. Not now hides the suggestion.
- **Chat rooms:** on servers that keep chat history, you see what was said before you came in. Other Hotline users see the ICQ flower (icon 25901) beside you.
- Emoji you type go out as classic text faces (:D, (Y)...), which every Hotline client can show.

**Downloads**
- Mac (Apple Silicon): `HIM_0.1.1_aarch64.dmg` · Mac (Intel): `HIM_0.1.1_x64.dmg`. Both signed and notarized.
- Windows: `HIM_0.1.1_x64-setup.exe` (or the `.msi`)
- Linux: `.deb` for x86_64 and arm64, or the Flatpaks

Using Adium or Pidgin? [purple-hotline](https://github.com/tagban/purple-hotline) brings Hotline messaging to them.

releases.title: HIM v0.1.0
releases.notes:
The first release of HIM, the Hotline Instant Messenger: a late-90s AIM-style buddy list for the Hotline IM network. It starts out on VesperNet; **Get a Screen Name** on the Sign On window makes an account.

- Buddy List, IM windows, away messages and auto-responses, offline messages, delivered/read receipts
- HOPE secure sign-on, with ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption when the server offers it
- Buddy Icons (the Buddy Icons extension, Janus 2.0.16+), including BadassBuddy zips as a searchable gallery
- AIM-style smileys, door sounds, and Hotline servers as chat rooms

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS, Apple silicon | `HIM_0.1.0_aarch64.dmg` (signed and notarized) |
| macOS, Intel | `HIM_0.1.0_x64.dmg` (signed and notarized) |
| Windows | `HIM_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe`, or the `.msi` |
| Linux | `HIM_v0.1.0_x86_64.flatpak` / `_aarch64.flatpak`, or the `.deb` |

The flatpak needs the GNOME 47 runtime: `flatpak install flathub org.gnome.Platform//47`, then `flatpak install --user HIM_v0.1.0_x86_64.flatpak`.
